title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 30: the rebellious children who run to Egypt, salvation in returning and rest, and the Assyrian struck down.

questions.text: What do the rebellious children do that brings the woe at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: They take counsel, but not from Yahweh, and set out to go down into Egypt without asking his advice, to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt.

answers.text: They go down into Egypt without asking Yahweh's advice
They worship the sun and the army of the sky
They rob the poor and needy at the city gate
They break the sabbath and despise the feasts

questions.text: Where are their princes and ambassadors said to be?
questions.explanation: Their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

questions.text: What name does Yahweh give Egypt because her help is vain?
questions.explanation: Because Egypt helps in vain and to no purpose, he has called her "Rahab who sits still."

questions.text: What is the prophet told to do with this word so it lasts for the time to come?
questions.explanation: He is told, "Go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever."

answers.text: Proclaim it aloud from the city walls
Seal it up until the very last day
Teach it diligently to the children
Write it on a tablet and inscribe it in a book

questions.text: What do the rebellious people tell the prophets to prophesy?
questions.explanation: They tell the seers, "Don't see!" and the prophets, "Don't prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits."

questions.text: How complete will the breaking be, in the picture of the potter's vessel?
questions.explanation: It will be broken like a potter's vessel, so that no piece is found good enough to take fire from the hearth or to dip up water out of the cistern.

answers.text: No piece will be left good enough to take fire or dip up water
The pieces will be gathered up and mended again
Half of the vessel will be left standing upright
The pieces will be buried outside the city walls

questions.text: In what did the Lord Yahweh say the people would be saved?
questions.explanation: He said, "You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence," but they refused.

questions.text: What will your ears hear a voice behind you saying?
questions.explanation: When you turn to the right hand or to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you saying, "This is the way. Walk in it."

answers.text: "This is the way. Walk in it"

questions.text: How bright will the light of the sun be in the day Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people?
questions.explanation: The light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days.

questions.text: Who will be dismayed through Yahweh's voice?
questions.explanation: Through Yahweh's voice the Assyrian will be dismayed, and he will strike him with his rod.
